competency_summary: Electrical safety and PPE; electrical measurements; wiring and installation; electrical machines and motors; basic electronics; installation/testing and troubleshooting.
official_source: Bharat Skills / DGT Electrician study material and curriculum
evidence: 2022 New Syllabus trade practical/theory; safety, tools, measurements and electrical installation topics are explicitly covered.

competency_summary: Fitting and assembly; marking, hacksawing, chiselling, filing and drilling; surface finishing; fastening; dimensional accuracy and tolerances; power-tool operation.
evidence: Official syllabus lists fitting/assembly, surface finishing, fastening tools and specified tolerances.

competency_summary: Gas welding; SMAW/arc welding; oxy-acetylene cutting; welding different joint types and positions; welding equipment setup; safety; inspection/testing.
evidence: Official one-year Welder syllabus lists gas welding, SMAW joints, oxy-acetylene equipment/cutting and safety.

competency_summary: Computer operation; programming assistance; computer programs and updates; web-page development; cybersecurity concepts; cloud concepts/services; documentation.
official_source: NCVET National Qualification Register / DGT COPA qualification file
evidence: Official qualification file states COPA covers computer operation/programming assistance, web pages, cybersecurity concepts and cloud concepts/services.

competency_summary: Electronic equipment servicing; measurement and testing; soldering/desoldering; electronic component handling; troubleshooting; installation/configuration; repair and maintenance.
official_source: Bharat Skills / DGT Electronics Mechanic study material
evidence: Official DGT portal provides 2022 New Syllabus practical/theory materials for Electronics Mechanic.

competency_summary: Pipe marking, shaping, fabrication, fitting and assembly; use of hand/power tools; pipework systems; safety; basic fitting operations; dimensional checking and threading.
official_source: NCVET National Qualification Register / Bharat Skills
evidence: NQR learning modules explicitly cover pipe fitting/assembly, safety and working effectively with others.

competency_summary: Aircraft structural assembly; interpretation of assembly drawings; drilling; riveting; reaming; structural fitting; safety/security; 5S.
evidence: NQR explicitly lists assembly drawings, drilling, riveting and reaming modules.

competency_summary: Technical drawing and drafting; drawing-sheet/layout standards; civil drafting practice; engineering drawing; CAD-oriented drafting study material.
evidence: Official DGT portal provides 2022 New Syllabus practical/theory material and engineering drawing resources.
